message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the long‑weekend holidays in Canada for 2023 (dates that fall on a weekday will give you an extra day off, creating a three‑day weekend).  
(If you’re in a province with additional holidays, you’ll want to add those too.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend? |
|---------|-------------|-------------|---------------|
| **New Year’s Day** | Jan 1 (Sunday) | Sunday | Yes – New Year’s Eve (Dec 31) + New Year’s Day (Jan 1) |
| **Family Day** (Alberta, BC, Saskatchewan, NB) | Feb 20 (Monday) | Monday | Yes – Feb 19 (Sunday) + Family Day (Feb 20) |
| **Good Friday** | Apr 7 (Friday) | Friday | Yes – Good Friday (Apr 7) + Easter Monday (Apr 10) |
| **Victoria Day** | May 22 (Monday) | Monday | Yes – May 21 (Sunday) + Victoria Day (May 22) |
| **Canada Day** | Jul 1 (Saturday) | Saturday | Yes – Canada Day (Jul 1) + Canada Day (observed) (Jul 3) |
| **Labour Day** | Sep 4 (Monday) | Monday | Yes – Sep 3 (Sunday) + Labour Day (Sep 4) |
| **Thanksgiving** | Oct 9 (Monday) | Monday | Yes – Oct 8 (Sunday) + Thanksgiving (Oct 9) |
| **Remembrance Day** | Nov 11 (Monday) | Monday | Yes – Nov 10 (Sunday) + Remembrance Day (Nov 11) |
| **Christmas Day** | Dec 25 (Monday) | Monday | Yes – Dec 24 (Sunday) + Christmas Day (Dec 25) |
| **Boxing Day** | Dec 26 (Tuesday) | Tuesday | Yes – Dec 26 (Tuesday) + Boxing Day (Dec 27) |

### Quick Tips for Your App
1. **Check Province/ Territory** – Some provinces have their own holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Ontario, Natal Day in Nova Scotia, etc.).  
2. **Observance Rules** – If a holiday falls on a weekend, it may be observed on the following Monday (or the preceding Friday).  
3. **API Integration** – You can use public APIs such as `https://date.nager.at/api/v3/PublicHolidays/2023/CA` to pull official holiday data programmatically.

Let me know if you’d like a more detailed breakdown or help integrating this into your code!
